modules.text: Uphance offers PLM for product development.
Uphance offers PIM / Product Data module.
Production module covers tech packs, BOMs, factory POs and incoming stock.
Inventory, Order, and Warehouse Management modules are offered.
Payments and Accounting modules cover invoicing, AR and AP, and financial reporting.
Uphance B2B is a branded wholesale buyer portal plus a Mobile Sales App for reps on iOS and Android.
Warehouse Management includes a mobile app tied to live order and inventory records.

customer_segments.text: Built for apparel and fashion brands managing wholesale, DTC, or multi-channel operations.
Targets brands running wholesale and DTC simultaneously with warehouse or 3PL complexity.
Has a dedicated solution page for activewear and athleisure brands.
Not for single-channel brands, businesses under $3M, or NetSuite/Dynamics/SAP users.

customer_size_signals.text: Serves apparel brands in the $5M to $100M revenue range.
A customer case reports 600+ retailer accounts ordering and 3 new brands plus 100+ new retailers in one year.
Platform holds a 4.9 rating on Capterra.

deployment.text: Described as a cloud-based platform with sales-led, no self-serve trial and no public pricing tiers.
Implementation takes six to sixteen weeks.
Onboarding steps: discovery, configuration, integrations and migration, UAT and training, go-live and hypercare.

integrations.text: Includes EDI, POS, Uphance Payments, tax, and 100+ direct carrier connections.
Shopify DTC orders draw from a shared inventory pool with wholesale and marketplace orders.
Customers integrate with JOOR or NuOrder alongside Uphance B2B.

differentiators.text: Positioned as replacing middleware, separate B2B portal, and standalone WMS.
B2B orders write directly into inventory allocation, production demand, and warehouse execution.
Compares itself against Cin7, NetSuite, Brightpearl and spreadsheets.

recent_news.text: Magnolia Pearl used Uphance for warehouse, shipping, payments, taxes/duties and returns; Lufema, an Australian brand, unified multi-entity operations.
Magnolia Pearl reportedly held oversell under 0.5 percent and compressed season planning by about 3 weeks.

gaps_or_opportunities.text: Uphance B2B lacks a cross-brand marketplace for buyer discovery, which JOOR/NuOrder offer.
No free trial or self-serve path.
